entry.confirm_signal: Four beeps (short short long short) 5 s after power-up at full throttle.
steps: Transmitter on, stick to full throttle.
Connect the main pack, switch on the receiver switch if one is fitted.
Stick to 'close' (motor off) within the window: sets the brake option and gives 1 or 2 beeps.
Or wait a further 5 s for the timing sequence.

announce.description: Timing modes sound as five repeats of a group of 1 to 4 beeps (mode N = N beeps per group). Frequency and cutoff modes sound as five repeats of a long tone, a tone plus beep, or two beeps. Rotation sounds as five repeats of tone-beep-tone.

select.description: Move the stick to 'close' between the first and fifth repeat of the wanted mode.

skip.description: Leave the stick at full throttle: the ESC runs on to the next menu after the five repeats.

scheme.confirm_signal: Timing or frequency set: one beep if the brake is on, two beeps if the brake is off. Brake set: two beeps (brake off).
scheme.exit: Disconnect the main pack; mode is stored when selected.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up for 5 s gives four beeps. Moving the stick to close then selects the brake option. Without moving, a further 5 s later the five-fold timing groups sound, then frequency groups, then rotation. Moving to close during the wanted group stores it; the pack is disconnected to repeat.

items.name: Brake

values.name: brake on (1 beep after the stick moves to close)
brake off (2 beeps after the stick moves to close)

items.note: Controllers other than Heli and Navy ship with the brake on.

items.name: Switching frequency
items.applies_when: models other than Master 04-3P, 08-3P, 18-3P and JES 04-3P, 08-3P, 18-3P

values.name: constant 5.3 V, 2 Li cells (tone plus beep x5)
constant 7.95 V, 3 Li cells (two beeps x5)

items.name: Rotation

values.name: reverse rotation (tone-beep-tone x5, stick back to off)

items.note: Master controllers only; other models swap two motor wires.

items.name: Heli mode
items.note: First-setting procedure for Heli controllers: full throttle, wait for the four beeps, stick to motor off.

unknowns: Beep and tone durations, gaps and the gap between repeats: not stated.
Which stick position or action advances from brake to timing: the text only says wait a further 5 s.
Item numbers 1-5 are the order of the sections, not sounded counts.
Whether the brake step toggles or sets: the manual says the brake option is chosen by moving to close and repeating after power-off.
Whether the cell counts in the table are NiCd or LiPo: not stated.
Rotation stored value and how a reversal is confirmed: not stated.
Spin Pro (Jeti_Spin_Pro_EN.pdf) is a one-page JetiBox menu chart: the only stick-related entry is 'Setting thru R/C'; no tone procedure is given for Spin Pro.
Navy controller first-setting result: after the four beeps and stick off, 2 beeps are heard; what option this sets is not stated.
notes: The Spin Pro chart (Jeti_Spin_Pro_EN.pdf) does not state that the Spin Pro uses this procedure; it is cited as the source of the 'Setting thru R/C' menu entry only.
Jeti_Spin_series.pdf states the 06-3P cannot change frequency; no 06-3P appears in the model tables (08-3P and 18-3P are listed).
